claim: A Standard workflow created in the Step Functions console is not configured to send logs to CloudWatch Logs, while an Express workflow created in the console is by default configured to send logs to CloudWatch Logs. If you create a Standard Workflow, or an Express Workflow using the API, CLI, or CloudFormation, Step Functions does not enable logging by default.

evidence.quote: When you create a Standard Workflow using the Step Functions console, that state machine will not be configured to send logs to CloudWatch Logs. When you create an Express Workflow using the Step Functions console, that state machine will by default be configured to send logs to CloudWatch Logs.

If you create a Standard Workflow, or an Express Workflow using the API, CLI, or CloudFormation, Step Functions will not enable logging by default, and you will need ensure your role has the necessary permissions.
